construct: Adrenarche is the age-related increase in adrenal zona reticularis secretion of DHEA, DHEAS, and androstenedione. It occurs independently of activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis and can produce pubic/axillary hair, body odor, oily skin, and acne before gonadarche.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Isolated pubic hair/body odor at age 7 without breast development or growth acceleration fits adrenarche, an adrenal zona-reticularis process separate from HPG-axis gonadarche.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: GnRH-driven ovarian estradiol would produce thelarche; GH does not directly cause pubic hair; an ovarian androgen tumor would be pathologic and typically more virilizing; TSH is not the driver.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The strongest concern is premature adrenarche versus normal adrenarche, but the lead asks for the physiologic process causing the signs, and both are mediated by adrenal androgen precursors from the zona reticularis.
